body:
## Which Dyson Airwrap should you buy?

Every Airwrap works the same way. A fast stream of air, rather than a very hot barrel, pulls hair around the curling barrels and sets the style, so there's less heat damage than with a curling tongs. The models differ in power, attachments and extras. These are the ones on sale in the UK now:

- **Airwrap Origin:** the entry-level multi-styler and dryer, with fewer attachments than the newer models. **Best value if you mainly want a smooth blow-dry and loose curls.**
- **Airwrap i.d.:** adds Bluetooth and the MyDyson app, which can set up a personalised curl routine, plus a full set of attachments. It comes in two versions: **Straight+Wavy**, for straight to wavy hair, with a wider barrel for looser waves and volume, and **Curly+Coily**, for curly and coily hair, with a narrower 30mm barrel for tighter, defined curls. Pick the version for your hair type, not the colour.
- **Airwrap Co-anda 2x:** Dyson's newest and most powerful Airwrap, aimed at faster drying and styling. It costs the most and, at full price, is hard to justify over the i.d. unless you have long, thick hair and style daily.
- **Airwrap multi-styler Complete Long:** the older full-kit model with long barrels. It's now listed from around £599, so the i.d. is better value.

For most people, the choice is between the Origin and the i.d. If you'd use the app and want the full attachment set, the i.d. is the one to have. If you just want a quicker blow-dry with a bit of bounce, the Origin at £329.99 does the job for £50 less.

## Cheaper alternatives

The **Shark FlexStyle** is the best-known rival. It's a 5-in-1 hair dryer and styler whose handle pivots to switch from drying to styling, with curling barrels, brushes and a concentrator. It doesn't quite match the Airwrap's curl hold, but many reviewers rate it close for well under the price. It's £269 today, but PriceSpy shows it as low as about £170 in the last three months, so **don't pay over £200 for it**. Black Friday is very likely to bring it back down. Our [Shark Black Friday deals guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) tracks it.

If you mostly straighten, a [ghd straightener](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) is cheaper and quicker than any air styler.

## What's a good price?

PriceSpy's three-month data and today's prices give these targets:

- **Airwrap Origin:** £329.99 at Argos is a fair price, £70 under its £399.99 list price. Treat anything under £330 as good.
- **Airwrap i.d.:** the cheapest major retailers are at £379, but it was down to £315 in the last three months. **Aim for £330 or less.**
- **Airwrap Co-anda 2x:** £579.99 is full price at the big retailers. It has been as low as about £415, so **don't buy it at full price**.
- **Shark FlexStyle:** **£200 or less.**

Watch for listings from small online sellers that undercut the big retailers by £50 or more. Some are fine, but buying from Dyson or a major retailer makes warranty claims simpler. Dyson's own two-year guarantee applies when you buy new from an authorised seller.

## When do Airwrap prices drop?

Dyson cuts prices for Black Friday (27 November 2026) and usually again before Christmas and in the January sales. Discounts on the Airwrap tend to be smaller than on Dyson's vacuums,. Dyson often adds a free gift, such as a case or extra attachment, instead of a deeper cut. That's worth having, but compare the price first.

The Airwrap is one of the most asked-for Christmas gifts, so the colours people want can sell out in December. If you're buying a present, Black Friday week is a good time to commit. For other Dyson products, see our [Dyson Black Friday deals guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/), or browse [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) and our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

### Which Dyson Airwrap is best?

The Airwrap i.d. is the best all-rounder for most people. Choose the Origin if you want to spend less, and the Co-anda 2x only if you want Dyson's most powerful styler and can get it well below full price.

### Is the Dyson Airwrap worth it?

If you'd use it several times a week, yes: it dries and styles in one go with less heat than tongs. If you'd use it now and then, the Shark FlexStyle does most of the same for less.

### Will the Dyson Airwrap be cheaper on Black Friday?

Probably. The Airwrap i.d. has already been £315 this autumn, £64 below today's best major-retailer price, so a Black Friday cut is likely.

### Straight+Wavy or Curly+Coily?

Choose by your natural hair type. Straight+Wavy suits straight to wavy hair and gives looser waves and volume. Curly+Coily has a narrower barrel and attachments designed for defining curly and coily hair.

### What's the cheapest Dyson Airwrap?

The Airwrap Origin, at £329.99 at Argos today.
